geometry: A 32 by 32 dark blue-gray square with perpendicular gradient fades, producing a soft transparent shadow on every edge. The central source color is approximately RGB 26,29,33 at alpha 178; fades extend about 7 pixels inward.
limitations: The gradient mask approximates the original soft fade; opacity accounts for renderer compositing. The 8x rendering was inspected.
qt5_compatibility: Rewritten without <mask>, <clipPath> or <filter>, which Qt5's SVG renderer ignores: masked gradient products became 1px strips, clips became hard-stop gradients or even-odd paths, and blur became stacked translucent shapes.
